passive.name: Serpentine Grace
passive.description: All Move Speed bonuses are more effective on Cassiopeia.

spells.name: Noxious Blast
spells.description: Cassiopeia blasts noxious gas, Poisoning enemies and dealing magic damage over seconds. Hitting a champion grants Cassiopeia % Move Speed decaying over seconds.

spells.name: Miasma
spells.description: Cassiopeia spews venom, leaving toxic clouds for seconds. Enemies in the clouds take magic damage per second, are Poisoned, Grounded, and Slowed by %.

spells.name: Twin Fang
spells.description: Cassiopeia launches deadly fangs, dealing magic damage. If the enemy is Poisoned, they take an additional magic damage and Cassiopeia restores Health, reduced to Health against lane minions and small monsters. If this kills the target, Cassiopeia restores Mana.

spells.name: Petrifying Gaze
spells.description: Cassiopeia unleashes a petrifying gaze, dealing magic damage and Stunning enemies facing her for seconds. Enemies facing away are Slowed by % decaying over the same duration instead.
